note: Maps a club name as spelled in ASFA's trial results to its name in ASFA's
club listing PDF, where automatic matching cannot bridge the two.
Matching is exact on a normalized token set, never fuzzy, so a club that
does not match lands in a visible 'unassigned' bucket rather than being
guessed into the wrong region. Add an entry here when that happens.
Keys are verbatim from the trial results, including any typos.
